text_block_list.text:
Umamusume racing through the pouring 
rain... Every one of them a proven runner 
who earned the right to run in the Nippon 
Derby.

Among them, there was one who stood alone— 
She was simply on another level.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...I see it. Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...!! You've gotta be kidding, she's still 
pulling away...?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, that's wrong! That path is...! That 
crown is...!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —Orfevre...! Aaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
O heavens. Rejoice to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Your offering was truly delightful.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And so, I say unto the common folk:

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Go wild with excitement to your hearts' 
content— With this, she is a Double Crown 
winner.
(...Waaaahhh!!)

The cheers were delayed by a beat, simply 
because everyone was utterly mesmerized by 
Orfevre.

Even while drenched in rain, she radiates 
brilliance... A brand-new, double-crowned 
"King."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, what a huge cheer...!! It 
feels like a live music venue...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
It's like... she blew the rain right away. 
So this is the power of Orfevre...—

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I was so pumped. After my last band 
broke up, I thought I'd never be able to 
dream again...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text:
“Still, her running... helped me get back 
on my feet again.”
(Oooooohhhh...!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre... was the real deal! This could 
be it...! The first in a long time...!"

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Towards the birth of a Triple Crown 
Umamusume...! Lady Orfevre! I will bear 
witness...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Band Member
text_block_list.text: ――...Me too. We can still...――

The hearts corroded by the rain were being 
purified by Orfevre's light... It was 
truly—a sight of hope.
choice_data_list:
(I definitely want to connect this—to the 
Triple Crown!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha, haha. A thunderous ovation... 
huh."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess it can't be helped. Because... 
even though she's soaking wet and covered 
in mud... she's shining.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
The droplet is shining... For that 
person's sake.

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...S-She's in a different league... Way 
too strong...

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...It's over. She's definitely going to 
take the next one too. My... my dream of 
the Classic races...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ………… ...No. I'm not... done yet—

As I prepare my words in advance to praise 
and revere Orfevre for her splendid 
victory, and wait—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't move.

—My vision went completely dark. Orfevre 
had suddenly thrown her mud-stained jacket 
right at me...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Keep it clean. I'm leaving.

"Before I could tell her she had a 
winner's interview, she hurried off... 
leaving me all alone."

"And so, with no other choice, I ended up 
doing the interview all by myself."
choice_data_list: The reason we won today was—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Why is Orfevre's Trainer covered in 
mud? And she isn't even around...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"No clue... but it sounds kinda fun. Maybe 
I'll ask for an interview next time."
choice_data_list:
(…If it's helping with publicity, then 
it's fine!)

text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's victory became widely known. A 
new Triple Crown Umamusume might finally 
be born after all this time... That 
anticipation was blooming in every corner.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
—I fell in love with Orfevre at first 
sight. I just tagged along with my partner 
to watch a race for the very first time, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Races are so incredibly powerful...! I 
feel like I've gained some energy from it.

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Still... things are still the way they are 
right now. Don't you think that's being a 
little careless?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But you know, if I can take the 
strength racing gave me and do something 
with it... I think that would be best.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
For her to become a Triple Crown 
Umamusume... At least to me, that is my 
hope—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're so amazing, Orfe-san! Everyone 
looks like they're having fun talking with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: We can't afford to lose either, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So that our races can reach even more 
people...!

—The next goal was finally the last crown, 
the 'Kikuka Sho'. If she won this race, 
Orfevre would become a Triple Crown 
Umamusume...

"If that happens, I should be able to give 
hope to even more people... I believe 
racing has that power—so all I can do is 
push forward."
choice_data_list:
Let's get you into perfect shape at summer 
camp!

text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy holds a summer training 
camp every year to hone skills. It's a 
great opportunity to elevate her abilities 
even further.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It must be quite sweltering, I imagine.
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure our heat precautions are 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Do not make me break a sweat.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However... summer, huh? Once we get past 
it—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Even the common folk surely understand by 
now... Whose realm this truly is..."

What will she be like after making it 
through summer, a time said to bring 
massive growth for an Umamusume...? Just 
imagining it sent a chill down my spine.
